title: crush after import older settings
symptom: After upgrading from AAPS 3.0.0.1 to 3.1.0.3, the app fails to open. Clearing data allows a clean start, but importing settings exported from an older version causes the app to crash again. Downgrading to 3.0.0.1 allows successful import.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the maintainer fixed it via a commit, implying a bug in the settings import.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit (d9b69f59d1a3f60916de861e44bef06d2ea45412). No specific user action is given.
